review_note: Adopted 5.7→5.8 delta + lefthook: comment hygiene (no-inline-comments:warn + AGENTS.md doctrine), packageManager pnpm@11.10.0. 5.8→5.11 delta adopted: added the missing .claude/hooks/* Claude-Code-hook script layer (previously inline `node -e` one-liners embedded in settings.json — block-no-verify.sh, protect-files.sh, user-prompt-guard.cjs, post-edit-typecheck.sh, post-tool-failure.sh, session-context.sh, skill-usage-log.sh, stop-checks.sh, subagent-stop.sh), rewired settings.json's hooks section to reference these scripts, added SubagentStop (net-new) and PostToolUseFailure, and fixed lefthook.yml's format-lint command missing an `exclude` list (was letting prettier/eslint reformat staged files — including these new hook scripts — and drift them off their harness.json baseline on first commit); version marker bumped 5.8.0 → 5.11.0. 5.11→5.14 sweep (2026-08-05): fixed the .env.example Read-block bug (permissions.deny's `Read(**/.env.*)` wildcard shadowed the explicit non-.example/.default variants already listed beside it), added harness.json to permissions.ask for hook-layer redundancy, SHA-pinned every floating GitHub Actions tag in ci.yml/security.yml, brought eslint.config.mjs's comment-hygiene rules to parity with the sibling kits (sonarjs/no-commented-code + no-inline-comments:error) and layered on the 5.13 mechanical comment-hygiene surfaces (PostToolUse hook, husky pre-commit warn step, CI hard-gate job) adapted to husky (this repo is not on lefthook). NOT adopted (same divergence as qkit, and still standing after this change): full tc harness-kit (bespoke CI here), pino route-logging enforcement, verify-harness/.harness-base re-sync (none seeded), better-auth/Drizzle add-skills. settings.json omits broad permissions.allow (auto-mode self-grant guard). This migration closes the Claude-Code-hook-script gap only, not a full harness-kit re-sync. 5.14→5.15 sweep (2026-08-15, cherry-pick style per this repo's standing bespoke-harness divergence): adopted eslint.config.mjs's sonarjs.configs.recommended rollout (~206/268 rules, up from the single hand-picked no-commented-code rule — real findings in app code fixed, not suppressed) and the next/eslint-config-next ^16.2.12 version floor (July security release CVEs). Closed a genuine pre-existing gap (not a documented divergence): next.config.ts had no headers() at all, unlike every sibling kit — added one modeled on qkit's, adapted to this app's actual origins (Supabase only — no Google OAuth here, so no googleusercontent img-src), and built with 5.15's dev-mode CSP/X-Frame-Options fix applied from the start (frame-ancestors/X-Frame-Options gated to non-development, learning from the bug the sibling kits still carry unfixed rather than copying it). NOT adopted this round: harness-kit.md's hook-command string→args[] array form (real, low-risk, but changing settings.json requires re-blessing its origin_hash in this file, and regen-harness.sh is explicitly human-run-only — an agent must not re-bless its own baseline change; flagged for a human to pick up). Same standing divergences as 5.11→5.14 (full tc harness-kit, pino route-logging, better-auth/Drizzle) still apply.
